title: Lifting the Shroud
description: Wilhelm, innkeeper at the Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead, believes Shroud Hearth Barrow is haunted. Investigate the barrow, uncover the truth about the ghost, and bring Wyndelius's Journal to Wilhelm for a reward.

base_facts: I run the Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead.
Shroud Hearth Barrow outside town is haunted — I have seen the ghost myself.
The haunting is terrible for my business.

LEARN_ABOUT_HAUNTING: An adventurer named Wyndelius Gatharian went to explore the barrow a year ago and never came back.
Screams were heard in the night after he entered the barrow.
ACCEPT_INVESTIGATION: Someone has volunteered to investigate the haunting at Shroud Hearth Barrow.
FOUND_JOURNAL: The ghost was Wyndelius Gatharian all along, using a Philter of the Phantom to appear spectral.
Wyndelius faked the haunting to scare people away while he searched for the sapphire dragon claw.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The mystery of the haunting is solved. I gave the adventurer the sapphire dragon claw as a reward.

beats.comment: Player learns about the haunted barrow from Wilhelm at Vilemyr Inn.
Player offers to investigate the haunting, starting the quest at stage 20.
Player finds Wyndelius's Journal in Shroud Hearth Barrow; quest advances to stage 30.
Quest completes after returning journal to Wilhelm at stage 200.
